title: Captured Earned and Remaining use the same maths as the on-screen report
refs: SV-8667 (WIP spec v24 per Chris Ward 2026-08-19; Story 11 S11-R3; S11-R5; S11-R7 corrected - the snapshot is read via the "as of" date)
preconds:
1. An open work order with known approved labor (partly clocked) and approved parts (partly received) is open on the day you inspect.
2. You can open the Work In Progress report and set its "as of" date..
steps:
1. On the report, note the work order's Earned and Remaining for today.
2. Set the "as of" date to the same day and read the same work order's Earned and Remaining from the reconstructed (snapshot) view.
3. Compare the pairs.
expected:
1. The captured Earned equals the on-screen Earned and the captured Remaining equals the on-screen Remaining, to the cent - the snapshot uses the identical computation for both figures, so the two can never diverge for a given work order and tab on the capture date.
2. The captured dollar values are stored to the cent - no rounding to whole dollars and no lost cents.

Note for the tester: you CAN check this from the report. On the day a snapshot was taken, the "as of" read shows the same Earned and Remaining as the live report, to the cent. If the two ever differ for a work order and tab, mark this test FAILED.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and story SV-8667 (WIP Story 11), and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S11-R3, S11-R5), as pinned and answered by Chris Ward on 19 August 2026, recorded in his answers in this file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bilalmuzamil-sketch/Manual-test-Cases/claude/slack-session-0sxnd9/build/report-suite/chris-answers-2026-08-19/WIP-CHRIS-RULINGS-2026-08-19.md.
This corrects the older wording (specification version 22), which said nothing in the report reads the snapshot back. Chris Ward confirmed on 19 August 2026 that the "as of" date reconstructs a past day from the snapshot, so the captured figures can be read and compared, so that newest source is followed here.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 28 August 2026: every requirement this case cites was read again in the live version and the behaviour above still matches it, so only the version cited above was updated.
